Likely part of a 'UV' (Universal) application suite.

DISPLAY ... LINE nn POSITION nn HIGH

purpose.domain_detail: Universal application suite sign-on/authentication module; likely a multi-company business application (retail/accounting ERP style) with user ID, password, company, and station management
purpose.summary: This program implements a terminal sign-on screen for a 'Universal' application suite (UVSON). It accepts a user ID and password, validates them against a system master file, optionally allows password change, records the sign-on date and station record, and sets a login switch environment variable. It enforces a 5-attempt security lockout.

notable_features: AcuCOBOL-style screen I/O with LINE/POSITION/HIGH/PROMPT TAB ECHO
SWITCH-1 hardware switch for bypassing date edit
21 COPY statements referencing uv/cpy/ copybook library
CALL to external subprograms UVACDT and UVDTCV
DECLARATIVES section with USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR
LGIN-FILE used to write environment variable setenv LGINSW
verdict.notes: Program is part of a larger 'UV' (Universal) application suite with a consistent copybook naming convention. The online-cics program_type is used loosely here — this is actually an AcuCOBOL terminal-based online program, not CICS. Century windowing via year>70 heuristic is present. No COMP-3 usage detected. Semicolons used as statement separators in SELECT clause (AcuCOBOL style).
